resources.string: Shrinks photos and videos you send to Discord so they fit under your upload limit. Other apps always get your original files, and your originals are never changed.
Squish can\'t see your Discord plan without your Discord login, and it never asks for it, so pick your limit here. Files already under the limit are sent as they are.
H.265 (HEVC): sharper at the same size
H.265 gives better quality for the same file size, but some devices, mostly computers, can\'t play it inside Discord, so people there would have to download it to watch.
This phone has no H.265 encoder, so Squish will use H.264.

In Discord, tap + and then Files. In the file screen, open the menu (☰) and choose Squish. Pick your photos or videos.\n\nOr share photos or videos from your gallery and choose \"Squish for Discord\".
Shrink some photos or videos here to see the result before using it in Discord.
Still too big, trying again smaller…
%1$s (%2$s long) will come out at about %3$dp and look blurry. Trimming it first gives better quality.
%1$s (%2$s) can\'t be shrunk: %3$s. It will be sent as is, and Discord may refuse it.
%1$s: %2$s\n\nSend the original instead? Discord may refuse it.
